tfc_definition: A deterministic, evidence-backed assessment of an explicit applicant, household or exploration-scenario snapshot against named destination rules or costs as of a stated date; never an affinity score or ordering criterion.
privacy_boundary: Guest-first, tab-memory default, explicit session/device retention only, no profile facts in releases, source artifacts, URLs, analytics, logs or implicit server persistence.
